data.long_meaning: The name Lennon is derived from the Irish root 'lenn' meaning 'lion' and the suffix 'on' meaning 'son of'. This name carries a powerful and fierce connotation, evoking images of courage and strength. The name Lennon carries the meaning “Son of a lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lennon usually hope their child will grow to embody son of a lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
